card.name: Last digit of numbers before units
card.fires_on: A digit that finishes a number, often the final 0 of a thousands figure like 600,000 or 3,000, or the last digit in a count or percentage. It sits just before a unit, a closing bracket or a percent sign.

modes.label: Final zero in large doses
modes.description: The last 0 of a comma-grouped number such as 600,000 or 5,000, right before units or mg.
modes.example: children aged < 6 years (or weight < 30 kg): 600,00<<0>> unitsIU in a single dose

modes.label: Last digit of a count or rate
modes.description: A final digit in an episode range, incidence percentage or patient count in trial results.

modes.label: Scale words and place values
modes.description: A scale word or digit in explanations of size or place value.
modes.example: A nanometer is a<< billion>>th of a meter

card.writes: It seems to promote scattered unit and number-related pieces, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a number just before its unit, such as the final zero in 600,000 units.
